about:
AGT Foods USA operates its ingredient production facility in Minot, North Dakota, as part of the global AGT Food and Ingredients Inc. The company, majority owned by Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited, traces its roots to a mission of providing clean, quality pulses and foodstuffs with reliable shipments and competitive pricing. While a specific founding year is not disclosed, the guiding principle "From Producer to the World" has shaped its growth into a diversified food company.

The Minot facility is one of two North American ingredient plants (the other in Regina, Saskatchewan) that clean, size, split, colour-sort, and package pulses and grains. The company runs 39 manufacturing facilities across five continents, producing over 1,400 products including flours, proteins, starches, fibres, extruded texturized plant proteins, gluten-free pasta, wheat semolina, rice, and bulgur wheat. It also offers co-packing, custom blends, and private-label production for retail brands such as Arbella, PastaVilla, Veggipasta, CLIC, and Tamam.

AGT Foods serves global packaged-food manufacturers, international retailers, and food-service channels, supplying plant-based ingredients and finished goods to 127 countries. Its integrated origination network buys crops directly from producers near its facilities in Canada, the United States, Türkiye, Australia, and South Africa, then processes and exports them through rail and port logistics partnerships.

The company emphasizes vertical integration—capturing value in the communities where crops are grown—and logistical advantages through bulk grain-handling agreements that connect Western Canadian farms to major railways and ports. Its Veggi line of 100% plant-based pastas, breadings, and meal kits exemplifies its focus on innovative, consumer-ready products.
